acs_scoring_set: H&E-selected anatomic study only; ISH-cluster samples are excluded from scoring by construction because their structure labels were assigned using expression
control_verdict: CONTROLS PARTLY BEHAVE: the best control (0.585) is below the median real method (0.800), but it ties or beats bayesian_hierarchical and control_shuffled_signature beats its own permutation null. The constraint set separates most methods from noise and does NOT separate all of them. Reported as-is; the constraint file is NOT retuned. Note the control is a SINGLE permutation — see the control calibration artefact before reading a tie as a property of the constraints.

control_audit.calibration_verdict: Against the hardest control (control_shuffled_signature, 95th percentile 0.492): every real method scores above it.

control_calibration.what_this_is: sampling distributions of the negative controls. Each leaderboard control row is ONE draw from these; nothing here changes a row, a control's definition, or the constraint file.

synthetic_mixtures.units: MAE as a fraction (source reports percent; divided by 100 here)
synthetic_mixtures.limitation: covers 2 method(s). A rank correlation needs at least 6. Extending it requires the cell-level single-cell data the mixtures were pooled from.

absolute_purity.reason: the predecessor project recorded ABSOLUTE purity as BLOCKED — no purity file was ever located — so the correlation exists for one frozen method only and cannot be recomputed for the others.

sc_pseudobulk.reason: requires paired single-cell GBM data where composition is counted rather than estimated. Not present in this repository.

implementation_disclosure.fallback_reason: music unavailable via R: R package MuSiC is not installed
implementation_disclosure.degeneracy_reason: reference 'gbmap_frozen' carries no cross-donor variance, so MuSiC's gene weighting is constant and the result is arithmetically NNLS. Reported as degenerate rather than as a MuSiC result.

implementation_disclosure.fallback_reason: dwls unavailable via R: R package DWLS is not installed
bisque unavailable via R: R package BisqueRNA is not installed
implementation_disclosure.degeneracy_reason: no subjects are assayed both as bulk and as single cells, so this runs Bisque's documented no-overlap mode (use.overlap = FALSE); the assay transform is estimated from marginal distributions rather than from paired subjects; the reference carries 0 donor profiles (< min_donors=3), so the per-gene reference marginal is taken across CELL TYPES instead of across donors — a different quantity standing in for the one the method specifies. Reported as degraded rather than as a Bisque result.

implementation_disclosure.fallback_reason: scdc unavailable via R: R package SCDC is not installed
scdc_ensemble unavailable via R: R package SCDC is not installed
implementation_disclosure.degeneracy_reason: one reference supplied ('gbmap_frozen'), so there is nothing to weight across: SCDC ENSEMBLE reduces exactly to SCDC. Reported as degenerate rather than as an ENSEMBLE result.

note: ACS is the object under test here, not a selection criterion. The method frozen for release is chosen by the outcome-blind pseudobulk benchmark, never by ACS.
